status: Open candidate findings, not Google Fonts waivers

explanations.googlefonts/metadata/consistent_repo_url: 1.9.0 compares whitespace tokens containing github.com with the repository path, including href markup and the required designer profile. Retain credits; resolve with GF/tool maintainers.
explanations.googlefonts/tofu: Both fonts encode U+0331. The Latin and Latin Extended serving definitions in the checker omit it, affecting five samples. The package requires an upstream serving-data change. Missing characters in the font remain blocking.
explanations.googlefonts/metadata/subsets_correct: Latin Core includes characters served by latin-ext despite under 20% coverage of that larger serving subset. Keep the declaration pending curator guidance.

findings.message:
The font has the following codepoints needed to render the poster lg sample text for language Siona, but although the font contained all the codepoints for the sample text, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets latin, latin-ext:

* ̱ (U+0331)

The font has the following codepoints needed to render the poster md sample text for language Chickasaw, but although the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets latin, latin-ext:

* ̱ (U+0331)

The font has the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text for language Amarakaeri, but although the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets latin, latin-ext:

* ̱ (U+0331)

The font has the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text for language Otomi, Mezquital, but although the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets latin, latin-ext:

* ̱ (U+0331)

The font has the following codepoints needed to render the specimen 16 sample text for language Secoya, but although the font contained all the base exemplars for the language, tofu will still be produced because the codepoints do not appear in any of the subsets latin, latin-ext:

* ̱ (U+0331)

Repository URL is https://github.com/NamcheAI/namche-fonts. But:

* HTML description has 'href="https://github.com/fizzybubbele">Michael'
* HTML description has 'href="https://github.com/NamcheAI/namche-fonts">the'
Please remove 'latin-ext' from METADATA.pb since less than 20% of its glyphs are supported by this font file.
